en.headline: 4 commits, 2 bug reports, and 1 discussion in openchamber
en.summary: On 2026-10-14, sogeisetsu made **4 own commits** across two repositories, with no pull requests, reviews, or releases. In `sogeisetsu/myBlog`, 3 commits added OpenChamber capture samples at three viewport sizes: `desktop-1440x900.jpg`, `panel-region-1to1.png`, and `mobile-390x844.jpg`. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, 1 own commit added truncation labeling to the daily report and AI summary when the collection cap is hit, plus 21 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. Two issues were opened on `openchamber/openchamber`: #4899 about browser captures exporting at CSS pixel size (1x) on a 200% display, and #4896 about agent-linked issues or PRs lacking an unlink affordance in the UI. `openchamber-bot[bot]` replied to both issues, marking each as `fix-ready` with a traced cause. A discussion was also started in `openchamber/openchamber` (#4893) titled "Picked attachments are dropped for text-only models - fall back to a path reference" in the Ideas category.

zh.headline: 4 次提交、2 个 bug 报告和 1 个讨论
zh.summary: 2026-10-14，sogeisetsu 在两个仓库中完成了 **4 次本人提交**，无 PR、无 review、无 release。在 `sogeisetsu/myBlog` 中，3 次提交添加了三种视口尺寸的 OpenChamber 截图样本：`desktop-1440x900.jpg`、`panel-region-1to1.png` 和 `mobile-390x844.jpg`。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中，1 次本人提交为日报和 AI 摘要添加了采集命中上限时的截断标注，另有 21 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。在 `openchamber/openchamber` 上开开了两个 issue：#4899 关于浏览器截图以 CSS 像素尺寸（1x）导出、在 200% 显示下分辨率减半的问题，以及 #4896 关于 agent 关联的 issue 或 PR 在 UI 中缺少解除关联入口的问题。`openchamber-bot[bot]` 对两个 issue 均进行了回复，将两者标记为 `fix-ready` 并追踪了根因。此外还在 `openchamber/openchamber` 发起了一个讨论（#4893），标题为"Picked attachments are dropped for text-only models - fall back to a path reference"，属于 Ideas 分类。
